test.error: Grammar constraint violated: EOG token not allowed

source_analysis: LLMModel::prepareSampler creates or reuses makeSampler(gen_cfg), then seeds it with sampler_->init(prompt_tokens).
Sampler::init iterates over every prompt token and calls geniex_sampler_context_accept.
geniex_sampler_context_accept first accepts the token into an attached grammar, then into the sampler chain and history.
This feeds input-prompt tokens into a grammar intended to constrain only newly generated output. The resulting path is consistent with the observed EOG-not-allowed exception.

A second independent source defect exists in generated-token handling: the fixed proc Sampler::sample calls geniex_sampler_context_sample, which already calls geniex_sampler_context_accept internally.

The fixed QAIRT LLMModel::sampleNextToken then calls sampler_->accept(tok) again. With an attached grammar this consumes each generated token twice. The setup-only R1 patch therefore does not repair the full path.
confidence_limit: The two source defects are supported by the pinned source and explicit host behavioral tests. The isolated R2 Android core now passes the A-versus-B discriminator, no-grammar recovery and two synthetic visual-click cases. Its malformed-grammar case still aborts, so the five-case suite is not all-pass. No production-domain or app action is proved.
candidate_action: Preserve the original runtime and its grammar-disabled v1 provider. Investigate the R2 malformed-grammar exception path, then qualify a separate repair; the existing C ABI already has a std::exception catch, so absence of that catch is not an established cause.

repair_candidate.source_changes: Detach output grammar before prompt-history initialization, attach a freshly validated grammar per response, and omit the second generated-token accept only for grammar-enabled requests.
repair_candidate.scope: Core-only candidate; retain the official processor, QNN, model, plugin and C worker.
